help.top:
Usage: dohc <command> <verb> [arguments] [options]

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.

Commands:
  document     Read, edit, and create live Markdown documents.
               read, edit, create
  chat         Read and post in Groups and threads.
               groups, threads, inbox, show, post, reply, react, grep, export
  dataset      Create, change, and use transactional Collections.
               list, describe, history, historyRevision, prepareHistoryRestore,
               permissions, setGrant, removeGrant, lifecycle, archive, restore,
               deletePreview, delete, pendingAttempts, reconcileAttempt,
               cancelAttempt, export, prepareRecovery, claimRecovery,
               discardRecovery, upload, file, createForm,
               prepareRelationChoices, create, prepare, approve, discard,
               prepareMigration, migrationPreviewPage, prepareSchemaChange,
               approveMigration, discardMigration, invoke
  app          Approve, open, and share apps.
               createLink, listLocal, prepareLocal, launchLocal, list, prepare,
               approve, cancel, withdraw, revokeCollection, reviewReactivation,
               responses, undo-responses
  history      Read the changes History records for files.
               list, show
  automation   Press Button fields, read an automation's runs, and try a failed
               run again.
               list, switch, buttons, runs, run, retry, press

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.

Run dohc <command> --help to see what each verb does.
help.dataset approve:
Usage: dohc dataset approve '<JSON>' [options]

Approve prepared source.

Fields: workspaceId, preparationId, revisionSha256
Optional fields: agentLabel
Take preparationId and revisionSha256 from the reviewed preparation.
agentLabel is an optional label supplied by the agent. With --as-agent, and
always through MCP, agentLabel is recorded as agent-declared. Without it, no
agent identity is recorded. Automation runs cannot approve or publish.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.
datasetPath is the caller-relative dataset.json path. List and describe return
it alongside the internal datasetId.
After moving the file, update commands and app manifests. An old path reports a
broken reference.
These verbs use the same Collection rules as dohc. They do not accept SQL or
caller identity.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.

help.app:
Usage: dohc app <verb> [arguments] [options]

Approve, open, and share apps.

Verbs:
  createLink           Create a scoped app link at View access by default.
  listLocal            List an app's publications on this computer.
  prepareLocal         Prepare an app to open on this computer.
  launchLocal          Get a local URL for an approved app.
  list                 List an app's shared publications.
  prepare              Prepare an app for a share link.
  approve              Publish a prepared app.
  cancel               Discard a prepared app before approval.
  withdraw             Stop a shared publication.
  revokeCollection     Remove a shared publication's Collection access.
  reviewReactivation   Prepare a stopped publication to publish again.
  responses            List responses link holders sent through a share link.
  undo-responses       Remove responses link holders sent through a share link.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.

Run dohc app <verb> --help to see its arguments and options.
help.app createLink:
Usage: dohc app createLink '<JSON>' [options]

Create a scoped app link at View access by default.

Fields: workspaceId, appRoot, operationId
Optional fields: paths, access, agentLabel
appRoot and paths resolve from your current folder (the workspace root through
MCP). paths default to the app root. access defaults to view.
Generate operationId as a UUID for this creation. Reuse operationId for retries.
A link URL is a bearer credential at its stated access level, usable by anyone
holding it. Append the published appQuery before the fragment of any link URL,
including one returned by createLink.
agentLabel is an optional label supplied by the agent. With --as-agent, and
always through MCP, agentLabel is recorded as agent-declared. Without it, no
agent identity is recorded. Automation runs cannot approve or publish.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.
help.app prepare:
Usage: dohc app prepare '<JSON>' [options]

Prepare an app for a share link.

Fields: workspaceId, appRoot, shareId, grantId
Set shareId to shareId from createLink.
Set grantId to grantId from createLink.
shareId and grantId name the share and its link grant. Review the result, then
approve.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.
help.app approve:
Usage: dohc app approve '<JSON>' [options]

Publish a prepared app.

Fields: workspaceId, approvalId, candidateDigest
Optional fields: agentLabel, linkReads
Set approvalId to approvalId from prepare.
Set candidateDigest to candidateDigest from prepare.
Take approvalId and candidateDigest from prepare, prepareLocal, or
reviewReactivation. Append the returned appQuery before the fragment of any link
URL, including one returned by createLink.
For linkReads, select operationId from the prepared dataset capability's
operations and fieldIds from each operation's fields[].fieldId. These selections
expose reads to link holders.
agentLabel is an optional label supplied by the agent. With --as-agent, and
always through MCP, agentLabel is recorded as agent-declared. Without it, no
agent identity is recorded. Automation runs cannot approve or publish.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.
help.app cancel:
Usage: dohc app cancel '<JSON>' [options]

Discard a prepared app before approval.

Fields: workspaceId, approvalId
Set approvalId to approvalId from prepare.
Use approvalId from prepareLocal or reviewReactivation to cancel those
preparations.
